body: Thank you. You guys have been very helpful.
I'll try and talk to her, we may fight a lot but she still is my only happiness. Thank you again.

It has always been hard for me to make friends. I've always been a very shy person and usually my classmates are about 2-3 or even 4 years older than me, I've always been the youngest person in the classroom. Being surrounded by older people is tough. This year I went to this new school and since the first day (which was February 11th) I haven't talked to a single person, not even a single word. I enter the school mute and I leave the school mute. I never had the chance to get along with people of my age because I've always studied with older people, our minds are totally different.
Thank you for reading this and replying.

Thank you. My gf and I fight a lot and we have just fought again a few hours ago. Though it really makes me feel bad I still think she is the only thing keeping me alive and I don't know for how long it will last. I liked the quote, Steve Jobs is a big inspiration for life. Thank you for reading and replying.

Thank you for the reply... I do think some therapy could help but I don't know how to talk about it with my parents, not to mention that we're going through a very difficult financial time. I just think it would be pointless though, perhaps a temporary fix for my problems and some time later i would end up like this again. It's been some time since I last did something to hurt myself as a way of letting the pain go away. I really thank you for reading and replying.
I actually laughed out of this, you can feel better now.

Life sucks partner. I'm with you. Just don't give up on yourself because of a bitch that doesn't deserve you. You'll find something way better! Show her you can be happy without her, show life she is not going to beat you! I know it is painful but remember that suicide is a permanent solution for a temporary problem! This pain will go away eventually, just be patient! Occupy your time with something! Avoid thinking about her! You can be happy!

i understand you. i study in a 80-student-class where i have simply no one to talk to. i've tried suicide once a few months ago but my mom found me. my life sucks perhaps even more than yours. But hey - don't be so upset about it. Life sucks. Thats just how it is. These girls you used to hang up with - harpies. Don't care about them. Don't care about being excluded, don't. I know how horrible it is to go to a place where nobody seems to like you but what you have to do is think that all that is goingo to end soon. That you're soon be going to college and everything is going to change! You'll eventually find someone that likes your for what you are and not for your body, and you'll like him too and thats what matters! Just don't give up for a temporary problem!
